entities.name: Burrenton
entities.description: A settlement led by its cenn, Deagan.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: A people for whom rope represents the ties that bind them.

entities.name: Ranya
entities.description: A skyhunter captain who passes on the Regent's orders to aid Mirrans.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: A metal plane whose inhabitants are called Mirrans and whose keeper dwells in the Panopticon.

entities.name: Conclave
entities.description: An order whose equenauts are scattered on the four winds searching for new places to take root.

entities.name: Orim
entities.description: A Samite inquisitor who speaks on the terrible power of justice.

entities.name: Brezard Skeinbow
entities.description: A captain of the guard who scoffs at the idea of the southern fortress being taken.

entities.name: Nim
entities.description: Creatures that raid homes without warning.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker who comes to understand that home is what you fight for.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane described as eroding with each passing gust.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: A leonin kha who speaks of commanding the terrain.

entities.name: Leonin
entities.description: A people led by a kha.

entities.name: Tal Terig
entities.description: Ruins scholars puzzled over for centuries, whose secrets lived within one rune-carved head.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: A people of observers who see things only for what they can teach; Lumengrid is the source of their arcana.

entities.name: Myr
entities.description: Constructs the vedalken saw as toys, unaware of their hidden intelligence.

entities.name: Sargis Haz
entities.description: An artificer who warns that machines will one day remind people they run the world.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Creator of machines whose factories were long destroyed.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A silver golem created to protect.

entities.name: Biskelion
entities.description: A construct created to destroy.

entities.name: Blinkmoth
entities.description: Creatures that avoid frogmite feeding grounds.

entities.name: Frogmite
entities.description: Creatures whose feeding grounds blinkmoths avoid.

entities.name: An Karras
entities.description: A mighty city built over thousands of years that fell in three hours.

entities.name: Pontifex
entities.description: An elder researcher who speaks of total command over his subjects.

entities.name: Gisulf
entities.description: An expedition survivor.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: A being to whose will even the clouds bend.

entities.name: Baron Sengir
entities.description: A being who compares bottled life to what he is used to consuming.

entities.name: Moonglove
entities.description: A substance that etches living tissue when diluted and kills a giant when concentrated.

entities.name: Argivian University

entities.name: Hanna

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: A ship whose navigator is Hanna.

entities.name: Panopticon

entities.description: An artifact forged at the Panopticon.

entities.name: Lumengrid

entities.name: Knowledge Pool

events.summary: The Regent orders the skyhunters to aid any Mirran battling anything strange, as relayed by Ranya.
events.quote: We're now to dispense aid to any Mirran we see battling anything . . . 'strange.' Regent's orders.

events.summary: Elspeth Tirel realizes that home is what you fight for.
events.quote: Finally, I understand. Home isn't where you rest. It's what you fight for.

events.summary: With Mishra's factories long destroyed, some of his creations still toil in remote areas.
events.quote: With their factories long destroyed, some of Mishra's creations still toil in remote areas, endlessly performing and reperforming their last orders.

events.summary: The mighty city of An Karras falls in three hours.
events.quote: The mighty city of An Karras, with its rich history, built over thousands of years, fell in three hours.

relations.quote: The Argivian University taught me two things: always look to the past, and never dismiss what appears useless.
Panopticon, forge of the Darksteel Eye, home of Mirrodin's keeper.

relations.note: Lumengrid is the site of the Knowledge Pool
relations.quote: Lumengrid, site of the Knowledge Pool, source of vedalken arcana.
The vedalken saw the myr as toys, unaware of the intelligence lurking behind their empty eyes.
Then they realized those places were frogmite feeding grounds.
